_meta.purpose: Upcoming shows for the Bolo Boys website. Only upcoming shows are listed here — past shows are covered by social media.
_meta.schema_notes: Each event follows the structure below. Claude populates this via the event_workflow defined in project-context.json.

logistics_notes.text: Example logistics note (band-facing only)

events.invitation_text: An evening on Krog Street with the South River Watershed Alliance — their Wild Fling benefit for a river that does a lot of quiet work for this city. We're the entertainment: two hours, good people, and a room full of folks who actually show up for the water. It's a ticketed benefit — from $30, with general admission, group and student options — and tickets are through South River, linked below.
events.additional_details: Ticketed benefit — from $30, with general admission, group-of-four and student/youth options at southriverga.org. Hosted at the Patagonia store on Krog Street. Doors and program run 7:30–9:30 PM.

external_links.title: Wild Fling '26 — tickets and event details

tickets.note: Ticketed South River Watershed Alliance benefit, from $30 (GA / group-of-four / student-youth). `type` is EMPTY on purpose: Bandsintown's accepted values for the Ticket Type column are not documented in anything this repo holds, and a wrong enum fails the row. Confirm on the BIT upload form, then set it. `price` is the lowest tier (GA from $30) for the JSON-LD offer. What matters most is the URL — without it, ticket-buyers were being sent to our own homepage.

logistics_notes.text: Load in through the elevator at the BACK of the store, on Krog St — pull up, unload, venue staff help wheel it up. (venue, 2026-08-19)
Band brings PA and all needed equipment — the host is not providing sound. (host, 2026-08-19)
Billed to the host as a FOUR-PIECE. (host, 2026-08-19)
Walk-through before show day so Paul can see the space; Paul owes the host a heads-up on timing (confirmed 2026-08-26).
Setup window 6:00-6:30 PM — a mad rush, but the host lets us start early (they don't use the space until 7). (host, 2026-09-29)
Doors 7:30, wrap 9:30. Drinks and food; a short break ~8:45-9:15 for a brief talk and the raffle. Casual. (host, 2026-09-29)

Placement SETTLED: in front of the slideshow screen (the 'Musician stool / mic / PA' spot on last year's floor plan), facing the food and tables. Host moves the coffee table and club chairs to clear the space. Screen runs a wildlife-photo slideshow as backdrop. (host, 2026-09-29)
Expected crowd: hoping for at least 50, maybe 70 — likely fewer than last year (25th anniversary). (host, 2026-09-29)
SRWA volunteer Zoom Tue 10/06 5:30 PM (floor plan, setup/breakdown, Q&A) — link not yet sent as of 9/29. Paul joining; band optional.

open_questions: PA power — where the outlets are at the screen spot. Settle at the walk-through.
Pay: never discussed. Still TBD with the host.

events.invitation_text: The first of our Friday nights at Wild Heaven Avondale — Dirty Shame, Acoustic Station, Ante Up and Bolo Boys taking turns through three 45-minute sets from 6:30 on. A full taproom, Al's kitchen going, and the kind of October evening that makes you glad the patio's still open. Free and all-ages, like every show we play here. Come hungry, come early.
events.additional_details: Three 45-minute sets from 6:30 PM. Indoor or outdoor depending on weather.
